scientific_integrity: Analytic proof plus self-contained symbolic checker. Sources compared at their actually accessible depth; no claim of independent certification or exhaustive priority is made.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the a=b, c=0 Markov family and the stationary coordinate observable, not arbitrary skew tent maps or measures. The invariant-density and topological/metric entropy observations are covered by general prior methods. The newly proposed exact covariance, resonance, and optimization formulas are self-reviewed; comprehensive priority and independent verification remain outstanding.
title: Exact covariance resonance and fluctuation-optimal tuning in a Markov skew tent family
